description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core MVC controller for managing 'Articles'. It provides HTTP endpoints for retrieving articles, retrieving article feeds, getting details of specific articles, creating new articles, editing existing articles, and deleting articles. The controller interacts with MediatR to handle request messages corresponding to each operation.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller class for handling article-related HTTP requests. Uses dependency injection to receive IMediator and defines actions for CRUD operations on articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of articles based on optional query parameters like tag, author, favorited, limit, and offset.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Retrieves a feed of articles, similar to Get, but with an internal flag set to indicate feed retrieval.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific article identified by the 'slug'.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new article based on the provided command object, requires authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing article identified by 'slug' using provided model data, requires authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an article identified by 'slug', requires authorization.
